ranks.rewardName: Title: Bounty Hunter + Heart Shaped Chocolate Box
Title: of Carri + Carri King Scepter
Embers Trail + Carrot on a Wand

deliver: The guild is building something. It needs a mountain of this.
Haul it to the table and count it twice.
Honest work for honest pay. Mostly honest.
The quartermaster is waiting, and the quartermaster is not patient.
find: Somewhere in the vault it waits for the right hands.
The collector pays well and asks few questions.
Chests lie. Keep opening them until one tells the truth.
Rumour says it is down there. Rumours pay when they are true.
kill: The guild pays for every one of them that stops breathing.
Too many of them crawl near the portals. Thin the herd.
Hunters before you tried. Their names are on the back of this paper.
Bring proof. Whatever is left of them will do.
mine: The deep veins sing for those with a sharp pick.
Ore runs thin near the surface. Go deeper.
Bring back what glitters, leave what does not.
The guild forges are cold. Fill them.
vault: The vault keeps its secrets for those who are quick.
Go in, get it done, come back with your boots still on.
Someone wagered you could not. Prove them wrong.
The clock in the vault does not wait, and neither does the guild.
